Servo +5 V rail - the three door servos
In the DRC 64's plugs at the end of the L3 leg's Control Unit branch (D-594), in its HVAC breakout
down RT14. +5 V to all three door servos (DV59): one conductor to the HVAC case, split there to the
three JR leads (P172). The firmware moves one servo at a time (F-017), so the conductor carries one
servo's stall current, 1-2.5 A. The far end stays capped until the luxury package fits the load

Wink request - the 18 k / 33 k ladder
On the CUR's sealed pigtail (D-615): the inline DRC 24 about 150 mm from the box, a 20 AWG
conductor through the rear grommet to the CUR board's J1 pin 7; the wink resistors on the CUR
board reach it on J1 pin 7: wink L NO through 18 kΩ, wink R NO through 33 kΩ (D-499); the wire's far
end is A8 in the PMU box
Wink and hazard commons - the PMU box's
On the CUR's sealed pigtail (D-615): the inline DRC 24 about 150 mm from the box, a 20 AWG
conductor through the rear grommet to the CUR board's J1 pin 8; wink L switch common on J1 pin
8; wink R switch common on J1 pin 8; the hazard's return too - the wire's far end is the PMU box's
ground star (D-603), never the board's GND
On the CUR's sealed pigtail (D-615): the inline DRC 24 about 150 mm from the box, a 20 AWG
conductor through the rear grommet to the CUR board's J1 pin 9; the hazard on J1 pin 9: through
4.7 kΩ to the latching button, the 47 kΩ baseline beside it to the winks' commons (D-368, D-589); the
wire's far end is A8 in the PMU box

Solid wire: live. Dashed: run and capped at the far end. A box on a wire is a resistor potted into the switch's pigtail (D-610); #12 / #16 / #20 is a circular's contact size. Generated by rx7.py diagrams - do not edit.
